title: Achuth G. Ramesh analyzes Ruben Hassid's newsletter funnel and builds his own AI newsletter
summary: Achuth G. Ramesh, not Ruben Hassid, speaks here. He has Claude research Hassid's and Webinity's newsletter funnels, then copies the model for a niche performance-marketing newsletter. Hassid's views are only Claude's secondhand summary, so nothing is attributable to him.
